title: Code history
description: How one variable's codes changed across waves, as the publisher documents it in multi-year documentation (e.g. FARS's code matrices by year range). One per line in metadata/histories.jsonl. Optional; provisional (STANDARD.md §5.4, §10).

id.description: Unique in the file: <table>/<name>, or <name> when the dataset has no tables.

name.description: The variable's current name (as in the latest release that has it).

element.description: The publisher's id for the documentation entry, e.g. FARS element C25. Histories that share an element come from one entry with several names.

names.description: The names the variable had, with the waves each applies to (e.g. HARM_EV, then PHARM_EV). By default they are names in this dataset's own files. Names from another of the publisher's products (YRBSS's single-year files, for a combined file) name that product's `source`.

source.description: Id in sources.yaml of the product these names belong to, when it isn't this dataset's data file.

periods.description: The publisher's periods, in order, in the units of dataset.yaml's wave dimension. An open-ended last period has no `to`.

attributes.description: One per row of the publisher's matrix: a label, verbatim, and its code in each period (null where the publisher shows none). pdt check requires one code per period.

origin.description: Where the matrix comes from: the publisher's documentation, with its location (page).
